## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and reason for the change.

## Documentation and setup

Link updated documentation. Describe configuration, migration, deployment, or recovery steps when relevant; otherwise explain why none are needed.

## Tests and validation

List added or updated tests and the behavior/regression/security boundary they cover. For documentation-only changes, describe link, instruction, example, and metadata checks instead of adding runtime tests that assert wording.

Record the commands actually run, results, and local/CI/live scope. Include the final tested commit and any checks not run with the reason.

## Release and remaining limits

State remaining blockers or unverified behavior. Record authorization and rollback target for any proposed deployment or hosted mutation; code readiness does not imply admin enrollment or hosted setup is complete.
